description: Strict integrated #11 + #13 sensor-attribute regression on the unchanged nine-recording panel.
hypothesis: On the integrated #11 presence and #13 reproducible ICP baseline, preserving sensor attributes changes no existing non-timing detector output.
tolerance_scope: Exact equality for all prior non-timing fields: continuous estimates, IDs, counters, flags and timestamps. The added sensor_attributes metadata is validated independently.
excluded_note: Only these operational timing fields plus the top-level sensor_attributes summary are excluded. Timing, throughput and RSS are reported, never used to assert a detector decision, field latency or recall. The sensor_attributes summary must remain present with unknown flags and availability counts in strict mode; it carries no detector-promotion flag.
provenance_note: Both variants include merged #11 and pending #13. Production source is bound to Git objects below. Identical reporting-only overlays are borrowed unchanged from PR #8 audit code and never imported by detector execution. Manifest Git discovery names the enclosing worktree, not the frozen snapshot. Both variants use the same newly rebuilt native binary.
panel: Supplementary EOF replay of the same 319 frames in two recordings; four diagnostic archives, including all three invalid-geometry frames. Not added independent observations.
